cleavage_agent.evidence: The excised gels were subjected to in-gel digestion using Trypsin/Lys-C Mix (Promega, 200 ng/gel slice) according to manufacture’s instruction.

collision_energy.evidence: The normalized collision energy was set to be 30.

instrument.evidence: NanoLC–MS/MS analyses were performed on a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and an Ultimate 3000 nanoLC pump (AMR) as described previously (Nat. Commun. 2018, 9, 1.).

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: The samples were loaded to SDS-PAGE gel, and resolved 1.0 cm by the running gel and fixed with 45% methanol/water containing 5% acetic acid for 20 min.

labeling.evidence: quantitative analysis of the dynamic changes in ER-associated proteins in response to tunicamycin-induced ER stress was performed by combining ER-specific labeling with SILAC (stable isotope labeling by amino acids in cell culture)-based quantitative MS technology.

reduction_concentration.evidence: After incubation, the beads were washed 5 times with the 1% SDS lysis buffer (1 mL) and 5 times with PBS (-) (1 mL), and then boiled in 2 × SDS–PAGE loading buffer (125 mM Tris, 10% glycerol, 0.01% bromophenol blue, 4% SDS, pH 6.8) containing 200 mM DTT for 5 min.
